zh: 新手引导改为示范演示：第一步自动播放一段写好的提问和回答，不再发出真实对话；数据抓取、数据导入、报表、一键催办、月报、大屏和运维待办都改成带示例数据的静态画面，秒开且不会空白，高亮框准确框住每个页面的重点区域。
en: The product tour now uses demos: the first step plays a prewritten question and reply instead of sending a real chat, and Data Capture, Data Import, Reports, One-Click Follow-Up, Monthly Report, Big Screen and Ops Drafts show instant static previews with sample data, so no step is empty and the highlight frames the key area of each page.
